Child Safety Standards & CSAE Policy

OrthodoxConnect has a strict zero-tolerance policy regarding Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) and any form of Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (CSAE).

Prevention & Moderation

  • Any content depicting, facilitating, or promoting child sexual abuse or exploitation is strictly prohibited.
  • Accounts detected sharing or engaging with CSAM/CSAE material will be immediately terminated and permanently banned.

Reporting to Authorities

OrthodoxConnect cooperates fully with legal authorities and reports identified instances of CSAM to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) and relevant law enforcement agencies.

User Reporting

Users can report violating content directly through the application's reporting features or by contacting safety support at: lucasautocode@gmail.com.
